hazards.control: Hands clear of handwheels and actuators; lockout on hydraulic controls before work.

name: Trailer deck, gooseneck, and axles
function: The trailer that carries both headers: deck beams, cross members, gooseneck to the tractor, landing legs, and the axles at the rear.

tabs.overview: Schematic in the model; the deck sets the header heights that the pump discharge and suction lines meet.
tabs.engineering: Highway trailer; leveled and chocked on location.
tabs.safety: Trip hazards on the deck; walkway used for the header side.
